## The Project
**NCLEX-PN trainer** — a cheap/free study tool + error journal + remediation coach for NCLEX-PN exam prep. Plain JSON files (phone-editable), your own notes + topic tags (no paid qbank text). Currently at remediation-trainer with a repeated-topics feature and a days-studied counter.

## Rules (Binding)
1. **rule — No paid qbank text.** Topic tags and your own notes only. Non-negotiable for copyright.
2. **rule — PN scope only.** Reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan. Zero RN scope (no independent assessment or treatment initiation). This goes in every plan template and guidance.
3. **rule/rule — Keep it local & private.** No GitHub, no packaging yet. Early stage.
4. **rule — JSON files, no database.** Phone-editable in a text editor.
5. **rule — One exception:** Days-studied counter on summary only. Rest of gamification is parked.

## What's Still Owed
**rule — Open obligation (blocker on study group sharing):**  
Before you show this to peers, someone with a nursing background (RPN/PN credential) needs to audit every plan template for scope-of-practice wording. Make sure it's accurate to PN/RPN role, not drifting into RN scope.

This blocks study-group sharing until checked. That's the only gate.
